annual_chronology_rule: Maximum original/later-completion date of full source must be strictly earlier than next-season first game. Annual ordinal counts must be contiguous for each team. Historical snapshots may be revised after season; no contemporaneous availability claim.

fixed_home_control.role: Uninformative fixed 0.5 probability reference; not home-win certainty.

evaluation.interpretation: HISTORICAL_RECONSTRUCTION_DEVELOPMENT; all periods previously reused or opened. Never holdout/prospective.
evaluation.quote_age: Descriptive only; no claimed live execution quality or policy change.
evaluation.snapshot_rule: Reuse exact existing eligible-game quote/raw-record hash, unique full identity and both prices; observed_at strictly before official/source scheduled starts and known actual firstPitch. Never select prices based on candidate performance.

feature_definition.annual_strength: (sum runs_for - sum runs_against)/games_played from the entire previous completed R season; no current-season update.
feature_definition.athletics_franchise_note: 2024 OAK and 2025 ATH both map to canonical Athletics/MLB133; verified exact CSV names, no fuzzy match.
feature_definition.evaluation_examples: 2026 existing 102 games with fixed 2025 annual aggregates.
feature_definition.home_advantage: Unpenalized intercept in home-win logistic regression.
feature_definition.missing: Exclude target if prior annual team absent; fail source integrity if unknown identities, invalid scores, inconsistent independent CSV labels, duplicate physical game keys or gaps in season ordinals. No imputation.
feature_definition.neutral_venues: Use official home designation, no added neutral-site adjustment.
feature_definition.suspension_rule: Use later completion date from Retrosheet field14; permit exactly once only if fully finished before next season starts. No within-season updates; no unnecessary per-game UTC.
feature_definition.warmup: None within target season; full completed prior season and all 30 franchise identities required.

hypothesis: Previous full-season run magnitude may add information beyond recent wins/losses; unproven.

success_interpretation.inference: Descriptive only; single opened development batch does not establish generalization or profitability.
success_interpretation.user_priority: Same-game qualified accuracy above market; probability quality not worse.

training.label: HOME iff final home runs > final away runs; no tie labels.
training.model_artifact_policy: Exclusive creation; if artifact exists, never retrain or overwrite. Replay uses saved coefficients only.
training.solver: Deterministic 2x2 damped Newton; zero initial parameters; max100 iterations, max20 backtracking halves, absolute gradient infinity-norm tolerance1e-8; fail rather than tune or switch.
training.standardization: Training examples only mean and population standard deviation; SD zero uses 1. Fixed training scaler applied to 2026.
